title: Trouble over temple land in Palani
content: First, it was Thirupparankundram. Now, it is Palani. Southern Tamil Nadu has been a hotbed of controversies surrounding religious places for some time now. The ownership and title of a parcel of land said to be within the precincts of the Dhandayuthapani Swamy Temple are now under debate, marking the first such controversy the TVK government has had to handle since taking office. The Hindu traces the origins of this conflict

title: Bangalore Metro Rail Corporation Limited to induct 13th Yellow Line train into service next week
content: Of the total 15 trainsets planned for the corridor, 13 will be deployed for regular passenger operations, while two will be maintained as reserve stock to ensure uninterrupted services during emergencies, scheduled maintenance, or unforeseen technical issues, according to officials.

title: Greater Bengaluru Authority revisits ORR revamp, proposes wider footpaths; seeks public opinion on white-topping

content: They deliberated on three proposals, including providing interest-free working capital loans to the farmers, giving various incentives and compensating the price deficit

content: The audit indicated serious deficiencies in the process of selection of beneficiaries and absence of adequate checks and balances before Direct Benefit Transfer to prevent such multiple payments, the CAG said

content: Home Minister Priyank Kharge said the State government will strengthen the Fire and Emergency Services and Disaster Response system to meet the growing demands of rapid industrialisation, urbanisation and technological development

title: Pinarayi Vijayan rejects allegations linking him to Exalogic case

title: Watch: CJP Protests: How Gen Z is redefining protests through posters at Jantar Mantar
content: Behind every protest slogan at Jantar Mantar is a poster that blends humour, memes and political messaging. From witty one-liners to pop culture references, protesters have turned placards into powerful tools of expression. In this video, The Hindu’s Aniket Singh Chauhan takes you through the funniest, most creative and thought-provoking posters from the ongoing Cockroach Janta Party protest, showing how Gen Z is reshaping the language of protest with satire, creativity and social media culture.

title: TCCI urges immediate FCI market intervention to prevent rise in rice prices
content: The chamber has urged the FCI to release rice stocks under the open market sale scheme to stabilise prices and ensure sufficient supply.

title: YSRCP demands HRD Minister Lokesh’s resignation over ‘DSC irregularities’
content: The party will launch an agitation along with students and youth if the Minister fails to quit, warns former MP Talari Rangaiah

title: Kerala delegation examines A.P. paddy procurement and PDS systems

title: Minister Shibu Baby John issues directives for complaint-free operations of IRE and KMML
content: The Minister instructed that both PSUs must resolve pressing local challenges, including land disputes and coastal erosion, while carrying out their operations.

title: Nandyal police hand over 549 recovered mobile phones to owners
content: Addressing the public, SP urges them to handle their phones with care, as they contain sensitive personal information and banking data

title: After 12 years at the helm, the BJP finds limited legroom for its political calculations
content: Young protesters have shown the government that a new cohort of leaders and voters is nipping at its heels; to engage with them, the government may have to shake its 12-year-old playbook

title: Forum opposes bifurcation of HDMC, launches awareness campaign
content: Terming the decision on bifurcation of Hubballi Dharwad Municipal Corporation (HDMC) as unscientific, Hubballi Dharwad Metropolitan City Forum has said that bifurcation would mean loss to both the twin cities particularly Dharwad and that the decision on the bifurcation had been taken by the elected representatives keeping the citizens in the dark

title: Quashing of FIRs, compensation & 5-point Charter: What Centre, CJP said in joint press meet
content: The Cockroach Janta Party ended its 36-day protest at Jantar Mantar. This decision followed three rounds of talks with the central government delegation. The government accepted two key demands, including the minister's resignation. All legal cases filed against protesters and organizers will now be withdrawn. The party continues to pursue compensation for families affected by the NEET paper leak.

title: One post, 6 words, 37 days, one resignation: How 'cockroaches' crawled into corridors of power
content: A six-word post on X sparked a massive student protest across India.  Thousands of students demanded accountability for examination irregularities and unemployment issues.  The sustained demonstrations pressured the government for over a month.  Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan eventually resigned from his post.  The movement, born online, achieved significant governmental concessions and assurances.

title: India crush Zimbabwe by 90 runs as Shreyas Iyer clinches first series win as captain
content: Chasing 220, Zimbabwe's task became difficult after losing five wickets inside the first nine overs. They were eventually bowled out for 129.

title: Jeff Bezos ex-wife MacKenzie Scott helped write a 'donation playbook' for Snap founder
content: Snap co-founder Evan Spiegel and Miranda Kerr have donated $550 million to erase medical debt. This significant contribution will benefit over 261,000 Californians facing financial hardship. The donation follows a philanthropic model pioneered by MacKenzie Scott. Undue Medical Debt will administer the funds, targeting vulnerable residents statewide. This initiative aims to unburden families from unpayable medical expenses.

title: Watch: Gymnast Gabriel Langton suffers frightening head-first fall at CWG 2026
content: England gymnast Gabriel Langton suffered a severe head-first fall during the men's team final.  This terrifying incident cast a shadow over the competition and halted proceedings.  Canada secured their first men's team gymnastics gold medal in twenty years.  Rival gymnasts expressed concern and offered support for the injured athlete.  Langton was conscious and speaking with doctors before being taken to hospital.

title: Pradhan quits: What oppn can learn from CJP-led students protest
content: In a remarkable turn of events, student protests led to resignation of Union minister Dharmendra Pradhan, showcasing the power of grassroots activism. The Cockroach Janata Party, born from online memes, played a pivotal role in this uprising. Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike also fueled the movement's progress, raising critical questions for opposition parties regarding their involvement in such significant demonstrations.

title: NY mayor hires Lina Khan who went after Amazon, Meta and Google in her days as FTC head
content: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani has roped in Lina Khan to lead the board of directors for the New York City Economic Development Corporation (EDC). The former chair of the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) known for her aggressive antitrust lawsuits against Big Tech. According to Business Insider, Mamdani called the duo a “dream team” and framed the appointments as a strategic effort to pair urban business growth with his progressive affordability agenda.

title: Dangerous parasite spreads north into US, but one smell may stop it
content: A dangerous parasite is spreading north, prompting urgent research into its specific attractants. Scientists are investigating foul-smelling chemical signals that lure the New World screwworm. This flesh-eating fly lays eggs in open wounds, feeding on living animal flesh. Current traps attract related flies, making detection of the dangerous species difficult. Understanding the parasite's preferred odors could lead to better detection and control methods.

title: After poaching erased wildlife, 12 giraffes may rescue this Uganda reserve
content: Uganda is moving endangered Nubian giraffes from Murchison Falls National Park to Ajai Wildlife Reserve. This relocation aims to protect the species from oil drilling and habitat pressures. Ajai Wildlife Reserve is undergoing ecological restoration and reintroduction of various animal species. Local communities are actively engaged and benefit from conservation efforts. The initiative seeks to foster coexistence between development and wildlife preservation.

title: Elon Musk's SpaceX in talks to sell Pentagon billions in AI data-centre capacity
content: SpaceX is discussing a multi-billion dollar deal with the US Defense Department. This agreement would provide data-center capacity for advanced artificial intelligence models. The Pentagon seeks to secure high-end compute power for its agencies and military units. SpaceX has recently signed similar cloud-compute deals with other major tech companies. This potential pact would significantly expand SpaceX's role in national security infrastructure.

title: Watch: Haaland brings 'Viking row' to Donnarumma's wedding as WC craze lives on
content: Manchester City striker Erling Haaland led guests in the Viking row celebration. This famous chant became synonymous with Norway's World Cup campaign. The event occurred during teammate Gianluigi Donnarumma's wedding festivities in Italy. Many prominent football personalities attended the lavish ceremony. Haaland's revival ensured the celebration's continued resonance with fans.

title: India script history, equal world record for most 200-plus T20I totals in a year
content: India achieved their ninth 200-plus total in T20Is for 2026. This performance matches their own world record set previously in 2024. Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma led the strong batting effort against Zimbabwe. They built crucial partnerships after an early batting collapse. India's batting continues to set new standards in the shortest format.

title: Dharmendra Pradhan resigns as Union education minister amid massive student protests
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position. He submitted his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This action comes amid ongoing protests concerning the NEET paper leak. The government has taken immediate cognizance of the irregularities. Investigations were handed over to the CBI, and the exam was cancelled.

title: Karnataka boy with no internet builds space startup working with NASA
content: Awais Ahmed's startup Pixxel secured a NASA contract for Earth-observation data.  His parents nurtured his curiosity with books, which sparked his interest in space.  He pursued engineering at BITS Pilani and met his co-founder there.  Together, they founded Pixxel to build a constellation of hyperspectral satellites.  This journey highlights the impact of early curiosity and parental investment.

title: Pakistan's embarrassing blunder, field six players in five-a-side hockey game vs India
content: The incident took place on Friday shortly after the match began, when the umpires noticed Pakistan had six players on the field. Under the rules of the five-a-side format, only five players are allowed.

title: Student leader to education minister: Dharmendra Pradhan's political career before NEET row
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned from his post on Saturday. He submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi due to ongoing protests. Pradhan's tenure saw the implementation of the National Education Policy 2020. His political journey began in student politics in Odisha many years ago. He previously held key portfolios in the Union government since 2014.

title: Who is Yash Thakur? Vidarbha pacer making his India debut against Zimbabwe
content: The 27-year-old fast bowler from Vidarbha earned his maiden India cap after consistent performances in domestic cricket and for India A.

title: Watch: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke falls to stage after being told Pradhan has resigned
content: Abhijeet Dipke fell on stage after learning of Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation.  He declared the resignation a victory but vowed protests would continue.  Dipke demanded compensation for families and action against police officers.  Pradhan accepted responsibility for the NEET paper leak controversy from the start.  Meanwhile, police dismissed rumors about a ban on food delivery services.

title: Shreyas Iyer's remarkable streak ends! India captain loses first T20I toss
content: Shreyas Iyer's remarkable eight-toss winning streak concluded in Harare on Saturday. Zimbabwe captain Sikandar Raza won the toss and chose to field first. Iyer admitted he would have preferred batting on the improved pitch conditions. Yash Thakur debuted for India, replacing Ashok Sharma in the lineup. Zimbabwe retained their unchanged playing eleven from the first match.

title: Priyanka, Alia, Vicky react to Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This development follows weeks of student protests concerning the NEET exam controversy. Many students celebrating the minister's resignation gathered at Jantar Mantar. Several Bollywood celebrities reacted positively to the news on social media platforms. Pradhan stated he took responsibility for the situation and respected youth aspirations.

title: 'We won't go': CJP's Dipke says protests to continue till all demands met
content: Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his post.  Protests at Jantar Mantar will continue until further demands are met.  The Cockroach Janata Party founder stated two remaining demands for the government.  Compensation of one crore rupees is sought for families of suicide victims.  Action against police for alleged brutality on July twentieth is also demanded.

title: 'Congratulations, My Dear Cockroaches': Prakash Raj reacts to Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation
content: Actor Prakash Raj congratulated protesters following Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. He praised their efforts for bringing a regime down to its knees. Dharmendra Pradhan announced his resignation in a public letter on X. He reflected on his commitment to students and education reforms. Celebrations followed the minister's resignation at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.

title: 'To ensure anti-national elements don't ...': Pradhan resigns - read full letter
content: Union education minister Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned from his position. He submitted his resignation letter to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This decision comes amidst ongoing protests concerning the NEET paper leak. Pradhan stated his commitment to students and education reform for decades. He expressed gratitude for the opportunity to serve the nation.

title: 2-month probe, 3-month trial: Govt proposes sweeping changes to anti-cheating law
content: Under the proposed Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, investigations into offences under the Act will have to be completed within two months. The Bill empowers the Central Government to constitute a special fast track courts, wherever necessary, for investigation of offences under the Act. The amendment also proposes that trials in special fast track courts  be conducted on a day-to-day basis and completed within three months from the date of filing of the chargesheet.

title: Gambhir termed 'foolish' after ex-India selector's Sooryavanshi verdict
content: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi achieved a significant milestone by scoring a T20I half-century. He became the youngest player ever to reach this batting achievement. This performance followed his earlier inclusion and subsequent exclusion from the team. Former player Krishnamachari Srikkanth criticized the decision to drop him. Sooryavanshi's dedication and fearless approach were also highlighted.

title: Millions with desk jobs, millions with cervical pain
content: The rise of neck pain among young professionals in India can be attributed to the demands of desk jobs. Extended exposure to screens coupled with poor posture is leading to this unsettling health trend. Many individuals face daily discomfort that detracts from their quality of life and productivity. Medical experts report a concerning increase in younger patients. To combat this, implementing ergonomic solutions and promoting movement breaks is essential.

title: 'Arrest me if you want': Wangchuk alleges harassment; hospital clarifies
content: Activist Sonam Wangchuk released a video alleging obstruction at Safdarjung Hospital.  He was transferred to Medanta Hospital in Gurugram after court intervention.  Hospital authorities stated the video was recorded before receiving the court's written order.  Wangchuk ended his hunger strike after receiving government assurances on his demands.  His protest focused on examination reforms and protecting peaceful demonstrators.

title: Bihar bandh: Tej Pratap Yadav detained as NEET protests intensify
content: A statewide bandh occurred in Bihar over the alleged NEET paper leak. Left-wing student groups organized protests and blocked roads in several districts. Authorities increased security measures and deployed additional police personnel across the state. Protesters demanded the resignation of the Union education minister for the alleged leak. The bandh followed earlier violent clashes and stone-pelting in Patna.

title: Ghost flats explained: Why some fully built homes remain empty despite India's housing shortage
content: In numerous Indian cities, a staggering number of finished apartments sit empty, transforming neighborhoods into ghost towns. Poor infrastructure and speculative investments keep these units unoccupied, frustrating the millions in search of affordable housing. This dilemma extends beyond India's borders, as countries worldwide grapple with similar housing market issues. Devoted constructors and investors often neglect the need for actual living spaces in their focus on profit and development.

title: 'Cops everywhere': Wangchuk's wife Gitanjali claims he's under constant police vigil
content: Sonam Wangchuk, hours after he ended his 26-day hunger strike in the presence of Union ministers JP Nadda and Jitendra Singh, said he made the decision only after he got assurances from the govt and MPs across party lines that his demands for exam reforms and no action against peaceful protesters would be met.

title: How Patrick Mahomes turned family support and adversity into NFL greatness
content: Patrick Mahomes says his greatest strength is not just football but the support of his family. From overcoming injuries to balancing life as a husband and father, he credits Brittany Mahomes and their children for keeping him grounded. His emotional words and never-give-up mindset show that resilience, patience and love have shaped both his life and his legendary NFL career.

title: 'Sack Pradhan from Cabinet': Rahul says ministerial reshuffle won't quell protest
content: "Students have three demands, and these are not negotiable demands... The first demand is that the Education Minister, who is corrupt, incompetent, and misaligned, has to be sacked... There's some talk going on in Modi's cabinet that the solution is to move Dharmendra Pradhan from education to some other ministry. This is not acceptable to the students of India. It is not acceptable to anybody," the Congress leader said.

title: Shabana Azmi tests positive for H1N1, says she's in isolation but getting on-ground protest updates
content: Shabana Azmi has tested positive for H1N1 and swine flu, running a 102-degree fever, and will isolate for five days. Despite missing the protests, she remains in touch with on-ground updates and expressed solidarity via a post featuring her father Kaifi Azmi's poem. She was earlier an active presence at the demonstrations before falling ill.

title: Delhi: Cab driver found stabbed to death in car; passengers under suspicion
content: A 40-year-old cab driver was discovered stabbed inside his vehicle in Krishna Nagar. Police suspect passengers hired the car shortly before the fatal incident occurred. Vijay Kumar was found with multiple stab wounds while inside the driver's seat. His wallet and phone were present, suggesting robbery was not the motive. A PCR call reported the discovery around 9 PM on Thursday night.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' Day 3: Vijay's film adds Rs 1.94 Cr, India net hits Rs 65.79 Cr
content: Thalapathy Vijay's 'Jana Nayagan' continues its strong theatrical run after a record opening.  The film has garnered over Rs 65 crore net in India within three days.  Worldwide gross collections for the movie have surpassed Rs 112 crore after two days.  Day two saw a decline in collections after its massive opening day performance.  Future weekend collections will determine the film's overall box office momentum.

title: Did CJP's 72-Hour Ultimatum Trigger Dharmendra Pradhan Exit? Inside Story
content: According to sources familiar with the negotiations, the turning point came during the second round of talks between the Centre and CJP representatives on Friday.

title: Next Round Of CJP-Centre Talks To Be Held In 4 Weeks
content: Soon after Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) on Saturday called off its 36-day protest at Jantar Mantar over the NEET issue with immediate effect, saying the government has accepted all its demands.

title: 'We Know The Pain': Assam Island Sends 20 Boats To Flood-Hit Neighbour
content: In a remarkable act of solidarity amid the ongoing flood crisis in Upper Assam, residents of Salmora in Majuli, world's largest river island, have voluntarily sent 20 traditional country boats to neighbouring Sivasagar to assist rescue operations in flood-hit areas.

title: Dharmendra Pradhan Resignation Live Updates: CJP Says Centre Has Agreed To More Demands, Asks Protesters To Return Home
content: Dharmendra Pradhan Resignation Live News Updates: CJP spokespersons Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka and Union ministers JP Nadda and Jitendra Singh held a joint press conference this evening, following the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan as Union Education Minister.

title: "MP (LS), Sambalpur": Dharmendra Pradhan Drops "Union Minister" From X Bio
content: Earlier on Saturday, Dharmendra Pradhan said in a social media post that he had submitted his resignation to PM Narendra Modi.

title: Heroes of Kargil: The Boys Who Climbed Into Legend
content: More than five hundred Indian soldiers did not come back from Kargil. Every single one of them was someone's child first, long before they were ever anyone's hero.

content: The coordinated operation was carried out on July 24 in connection with STF Police Station Case No. 06/2026, following specific intelligence inputs.

title: 'Nation Not Built By Resignation Alone, Need Reforms': Sonam Wangchuk After CJP Ends Protest
content: The protest at Jantar Mantar began on June 6 and gained wider attention after Sonam Wangchuk joined with an indefinite hunger strike on June 28. He ended the fast on Thursday night after 26 days

title: CJP Ends Protest As Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns, More Demands Met
content: The announcement came in a joint government-CJP press conference this evening, following the resignation of Dharmendra Pradhan as Union Education Minister. His resignation was the CJP's core demand

title: Student Power That Worked In 1997 Returns To Haunt Dharmendra Pradhan In 2026
content: Nearly 30 years ago, around 1,500 students gathered outside the Odisha state secretariat to protest an exam paper leak. One among them, would later become the Education Minister of India. He was Dharmendra Pradhan.

title: Centre Agrees To 2 More Demands, Says CJP In Joint Press Meet
content: Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, the leader from Odisha, announced his resignation before the much-anticipated third round of talks this afternoon.

title: "Kept Worrying, Lost Appetite, But Extremely Proud": Abhijeet Dipke's Mother
content: Anita Dipke said she couldn't sleep or eat properly because she was worried about her son, Abhijeet Dipke, who has been spearheading a students' protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar.

title: "Courage Without Violence": Gitanjali Angmo On Gen Z As Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns
content: Angmo's reaction comes hours after Pradhan resigned as India's Education Minister following a month-long protest by students seeking his resignation. The leader said he had submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

title: "Students Should Vacate Jantar Mantar": Cops Announce On Loudspeakers As Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns
content: Policemen using loudspeakers asked the protesters to vacate the place, now that their demand has been met

title: "People Being Instigated": Himachal Governor On CJP Paper Leak Protest
content: Himachal Pradesh Governor Kavinder Gupta has questioned the motive behind the ongoing Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protest, alleging that the agitation has moved beyond its original issues and is now being used to push a larger agenda.

title: Abhijeet Dipke's "Going To Take A Nap" Post Shortly After Dharmendra Pradhan Resigns
content: The social media-driven CJP spearheaded student protests that broke out in response to exam paper leaks, and is seeking systemic reforms in the education system.

title: Behind The Scenes: Lawyers Step In To Defend Detained CJP Student Protesters
content: Since July 20, a team of advocates from the Bombay High Court has been providing free legal assistance to students detained during protests held across Mumbai.

content: The moment the news broke, the atmosphere at Jantar Mantar turned celebratory with the crowd of protesters cheering, dancing, singing and waiving Indian flags under yellow canopies.
